name: openrmm
description: Open-source Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM): lightweight Node.js agent, Fastify server, React dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openrmm/shared && npm run build -w @openrmm/server && npm run build -w @openrmm/agent && npm run build -w @openrmm/dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,dashboard -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:dashboard"
